title: Settings page/control inventory for native POS audit

provenance.method: Read-only source inspection of all settings route scripts, markup and linked control helpers.
provenance.note: This is a checklist and source evidence. It does not assert native runtime, external service or hardware passes.

coverage.countMethod: Literal tag sites in19 +page.svelte files. Loops, inherited Back, Modal/ConfirmDialog/CustomSelect/SearchField/TouchDigitPad internals and conditionally hidden states mean runtime counts differ. A control family explicitly lists its repeated choices when fixed.

statusVocabulary.source_inspected_only: Read handler and markup, not executed.
statusVocabulary.runtime_pass: Root must attach native action plus observed result/evidence.
statusVocabulary.runtime_issue: Root must attach reproducible native action/result.
statusVocabulary.dependency_blocked: Needs physical hardware, external fixture, credentials, connectivity or isolated destructive dataset.

uiChecksForEveryRoute: Open from its visible parent link and verify header, title, Back, active mode and permissions.
Checkout and Back Office: test keyboard focus, Tab/Shift-Tab, Enter and Escape where supported; on-screen keyboard absent in Back Office.
Square POS client area: check no horizontal overflow, clipped labels, unreachable bottom actions, conflicting scroll containers or modal outside viewport.
Check narrow/square and larger desktop widths with normal and Extra large section/modal fonts.
Click every enabled action once and every repeated fixed choice at least once; inspect disabled reason/state.
For reversible configuration, record original value, save/test persistence after revisit and restore original.
Open, cancel and close every modal; verify focus returns, background cannot receive actions and busy dismissal behaves correctly.
Validate empty/no records, populated/long names, loading, dependency-offline and persistence/provider failure states.
Hardware/API success needs actual configured service; do not equate button invocation or toast with confirmed physical/provider outcome.
Final delete/restore/migrate/push/key-removal/licence/seat/module financial/external actions need isolated fixture or explicit intended mutation; source-only coverage must be labelled.

sourceFindings.title: Several settings show an unsaved value when database persistence fails
sourceFindings.evidence: Each handler updates settingsDB or storeDB before awaiting upsert. These handlers have no catch, rollback or local error state. Event callbacks also do not consume the rejected promise.
sourceFindings.impact: A blocked/failed local or shared setting write can leave the operator seeing On, a new target, or a changed tax mode even though it was not persisted; re-entry/restart then changes it back.
sourceFindings.reproduction: In an isolated fixture, force a settings write to fail and change a sound switch, scale enabled/port, printer transport, or Save Tax Mode. Compare on-screen state to persisted settings and unhandled rejection.
sourceFindings.expected: Catch persistence errors, show actionable failure and retain/revert the prior saved state.

sourceFindings.title: Printer and drawer tests allow overlapping repeated operations
sourceFindings.evidence: Test Receipt, Test Label and Open Drawer have no in-flight flag or early busy return; disabled conditions only depend on configuration. Clicking while the first awaited request is running invokes another job.
sourceFindings.impact: Multiple unintended physical test receipts/labels or drawer pulses; concurrent results can overwrite each other.
sourceFindings.reproduction: With an isolated slow mock/hardware transport, double-click each test while the first status says Sending/Opening.
sourceFindings.expected: Busy state prevents concurrent repeat until the first request settles.

sourceFindings.title: Barcode tester labels unchecked check digits Valid
sourceFindings.evidence: Successful tester markup renders Check digit: Valid unconditionally. Parser only checks EAN-13 validity when validateCheckDigit is true.
sourceFindings.impact: With Validate check digit off, a barcode with an incorrect digit can be accepted by the intended rule but falsely reported as validated.
sourceFindings.reproduction: Disable Validate check digit in a draft rule, enter a matching13-digit code with an incorrect final digit, press Test.
sourceFindings.expected: Show Not checked when validation is disabled; display Valid only after an actual check.

sourceFindings.title: Switching card provider can leave both providers disabled after a save failure
sourceFindings.evidence: Each enable path first persists enabled:false for the other provider, then awaits saveConfiguration(true). saveConfiguration catches failures and returns false; there is no rollback of the previously enabled provider.
sourceFindings.impact: If new-provider config validation/journal guard/write fails after the old provider was disabled, card checkout loses its prior working integration until manually re-enabled.
sourceFindings.reproduction: In fixture with providerA enabled, enable ready providerB while forcing B save to fail; reload both native configs.
sourceFindings.expected: Atomic or recoverable switching preserving the working provider, or explicit visible recovery instructions/state.

sourceFindings.title: Provider status screen turns a load error into Setup required
sourceFindings.evidence: Rejected loadDojoConfig/loadSumupConfig only console.warn; null config is later rendered as Setup required.
sourceFindings.impact: A transient native config read failure looks like absent credentials and encourages unnecessary reconfiguration.
sourceFindings.reproduction: Reject one provider config read while opening Card Payments; observe provider tile state.
sourceFindings.expected: Separate Could not load/Retry state from genuinely missing setup.

sourceFindings.title: Some maintenance diagnostic failures have no visible completion/error state
sourceFindings.evidence: refreshConflicts, performConflictDismiss and validateSchemas await fallible operations without try/catch. validateSchemas sets Checking databases before the await; on rejection that status stays unchanged.
sourceFindings.impact: Schema validation can remain visually checking; conflict refresh/dismiss failure may appear inert or escape only as an unhandled rejection.
sourceFindings.reproduction: In isolated fixture reject schema validation or conflict read/delete, then click the corresponding control.
sourceFindings.expected: Finish busy/status states and show a readable failure with retry.

sourceFindings.title: Concurrent font saves can revert a newer successful choice
sourceFindings.evidence: Font choices remain enabled while saving. Every update captures a previous row and unconditionally restores it on error, then clears pendingSettings for the key. There is no per-key version or stale-result guard.
sourceFindings.impact: If earlier requestA fails after later choiceB succeeds, A rollback can overwrite the UI with an older font/size, while the persisted setting remainsB.
sourceFindings.reproduction: StartA thenB for the same font key; letB complete successfully andA reject afterwards; compare UI and stored value.
sourceFindings.expected: Serialize per-key updates or ignore stale completion/rollback so the newest successful selection remains displayed.
